# Netrani Island

> A guide to Netrani Island (Pigeon Island), a heart-shaped island about 19 km off Murudeshwar in Uttara Kannada, Karnataka, India, and the coral reef around it. Visitors reach it only by boat from Murudeshwar beach for scuba diving, snorkelling and boat trips; landing on the island is not allowed. The diving season is roughly October to May.

Booking desk (calls and WhatsApp): +91 78290 08264. Prices: https://netraniisland.com/pricing (snorkelling from ₹2,200 per guest, private boats from ₹18,000 for six people; scuba is quoted per date).

## Guides
- [Is Scuba Diving Safe at Netrani? An Honest Guide for First-Timers](https://netraniisland.com/blog/is-scuba-diving-safe-netrani): For healthy beginners who follow the briefing, a Netrani try dive is generally safe. The rules behind it, the real risks, why days get cancelled, what to ask.
- [Murudeshwar Trip Plan: A 2-Day Itinerary with Netrani Island](https://netraniisland.com/blog/murudeshwar-netrani-2-day-trip-plan): A 2-day Murudeshwar trip plan: temple, Shiva statue, Raja Gopura and beach on day one, the Netrani boat on day two, then Gokarna or Kollur. Timings and tips.
- [Murudeshwar Water Sports and Boating: Prices, Rides and Netrani](https://netraniisland.com/blog/murudeshwar-water-sports-boating): Murudeshwar water sports prices: jet ski ₹400–500, banana boat ₹300, speed boat ₹1,500, parasailing ₹800–1,000. What each ride is like, plus the Netrani boat.
- [Netrani Island Best Time to Visit: Season, Months and Is It Open Now](https://netraniisland.com/blog/netrani-island-season-best-time): Netrani Island boats run roughly October to May and stop in the monsoon; December to February is usually calmest. Month-by-month guide and whether it is open now.
- [Netrani Island Resort and Stay: Where to Sleep for the Boat Trip](https://netraniisland.com/blog/netrani-island-resort-where-to-stay): There is no resort or stay on Netrani Island and visitors do not land. Sleep in Murudeshwar, 19 km away, the night before your morning boat. Where to book.
- [Netrani Island Scuba Diving: A First-Timer's Guide to the Dive Day](https://netraniisland.com/blog/netrani-island-scuba-diving-guide): Netrani scuba diving starts with a 19 km boat ride from Murudeshwar beach. See the dive day step by step, who can dive, the season and how the price is set.
- [Netrani Scuba Diving Age Limit: Kids, Seniors and Non-Swimmers](https://netraniisland.com/blog/netrani-scuba-diving-age-limit): The minimum age for a Netrani try dive is usually 10. PADI sets no upper age, but a medical form decides. What applies to kids, over-45s and non-swimmers.
- [Scuba Diving in Karnataka: Where to Dive and Why Netrani Leads](https://netraniisland.com/blog/scuba-diving-in-karnataka): Netrani Island, 19 km off Murudeshwar, is Karnataka's main coral reef dive. See how Kapu, Karwar and Malpe compare and how to plan the trip from Bengaluru.
- [Snorkeling vs Scuba Diving at Netrani: Which One Suits You?](https://netraniisland.com/blog/snorkeling-vs-scuba-diving-netrani): Snorkelling at Netrani keeps you at the surface from ₹2,200 per guest; scuba takes you under with an instructor. Compare swimming, depth, age, cost, photos.
- [Pigeon Island Karnataka: Netrani Island Scuba & Reach](https://netraniisland.com/blog/pigeon-island-netrani-island-scuba-diving-murudeshwar): Pigeon Island is Netrani Island near Murudeshwar, Karnataka. Learn how to reach, scuba/snorkeling options, season, boat timings, and booking links.
- [Netrani Island Scuba Diving for Beginners: Checklist](https://netraniisland.com/blog/netrani-first-dive-checklist): Use this first-time Netrani Island scuba checklist to prepare before booking, handle the boat ride, ask the crew better questions, and avoid beginner mistakes.
- [Netrani Island Water Clarity: Best Months to Dive](https://netraniisland.com/blog/netrani-water-clarity-calendar): See Netrani Island water clarity by month: October-May dive season, December-February visibility odds, monsoon limits, and week-of weather checks.
- [Murudeshwar to Netrani Island Boat Timings Guide](https://netraniisland.com/blog/murudeshwar-boat-timings-guide): See Murudeshwar to Netrani Island boat timings: morning reporting, 45-60 minute crossing, same-day return, and buffer planning for scuba or snorkeling.
- [Netrani Island Marine Life: What Divers Usually See](https://netraniisland.com/blog/marine-life-you-can-see-at-netrani): See the marine life divers usually notice at Netrani Island: reef fish, coral movement, occasional turtles, visibility factors, and scuba vs snorkeling expectations.
- [Who Should Not Scuba Dive at Netrani Island?](https://netraniisland.com/blog/who-should-skip-a-dive): Know when to pause a Netrani Island scuba dive: blocked ears, congestion, illness, seasickness, medication changes, pregnancy questions, and medical clearance.
- [Netrani Island Packing List: What to Bring](https://netraniisland.com/blog/what-to-pack-for-netrani-day-trip): Pack smart for a Netrani Island boat trip with water, towel, dry clothes, sunscreen, dry storage, and a clear list of what to leave at the hotel.
